Question_text: Earnshaw is a company that buys raw materials and components in bulk. It uses them to manufacture furniture using flow production methods. Productivity in the factory is high. Currently Earnshaw has high costs of holding stock. The Managing Director wants to introduce lean production methods.
Sub_topic: Features, benefits, limitations: job, batch, flow production

Parts.part_text: What is meant by 'productivity'?
Identify two advantages to Earnshaw of buying raw materials in bulk.
Identify and explain two features of flow production.
Identify and explain three benefits to Earnshaw of using lean production methods.
'If Earnshaw is to grow in the future then its unit production costs must fall'. Do you agree? Justify your answer.

Question_text: Muammar sells boxes of spices to markets. Workers in Muammar's business are paid on a piece rate basis. Table 1 gives financial details of the business in 2012. Table 1 Fixed costs per month $10000 Employee wages $2 per box Raw materials $3 per box Marketing costs $1 per box Selling price $8 per box Sales per month [average] 9000 boxes
Sub_topic: Classify costs: fixed, variable, average, total
Features: revenue, cost of sales, gross profit, profit, retained profit
Financial rewards: wage, salary, bonus, commission, profit sharing

Parts.part_text: Identify two examples of fixed costs for Muammar's business.
Identify two reasons why sales may vary from month to month.
Calculate the annual profit that Muammar made in 2012.
Identify and explain one advantage and one disadvantage to Muammar of using piece rate to pay his workers.
Muammar is planning to change the selling price of the boxes to $7 each. Do you think this change would benefit the business? Justify your answer.

Question_text: Yura is the Managing Director of a company that sells holidays. The company organises hotels, air flights and car hire for customers. For the first time, the company is going to do some market research. Secondary sources will be used and a sample of customers will be selected for primary research.
Sub_topic: Primary methods: postal questionnaire, online survey, interviews, focus groups
Secondary methods: online, government sources, commercial reports

Parts.part_text: What is meant by 'market research'?
Identify two advantages of using secondary sources.
Identify and explain two methods of sampling that the company could use.
Identify and explain two ways of segmenting the market for holidays that the company could use.
Yura believes that the price is the most important part of the marketing mix for holidays. Do you think that he is correct? Justify your answer.

Question_text: Table 2 gives data about the economy of country C. Table 2 Year National income per person ($) Inflation (%) Unemployment (%) 2010 650 5 10 2011 640 3 12 2012 600 1.5 18 The economy of country C is in recession. The Government wants to create more jobs by encouraging more businesses to start up. However some pressure groups are against this because they think that more businesses will cause more external (social) costs.
Unit: UNIT 6: External influences on business activity
Sub_topic: Stages of business cycle: growth, boom, recession, slump
Government support for start-ups, grants, training schemes

Parts.part_text: What is meant by 'recession'?
Identify two possible reasons why national income per person has fallen between 2010 and 2012.
Identify and explain two ways that a Government could help new businesses to start up.
Identify and explain three external (social) costs that might be caused by an increase in the number of businesses in country C.
Do you think that new start-up businesses can be successful in country C? Justify your answer.

Question_text: Dmit is a partner in a small retail clothing business. The business has been successful, but it is finding it difficult to compete against larger retailers. The partners are thinking of converting the partnership into a private limited company.
Sub_topic: Features: sole traders, partnerships, private/public limited companies, franchises, joint ventures

Parts.part_text: Identify two features of a partnership.
Identify two ways of measuring the success of a business.
Identify and explain two reasons why the business might be finding it difficult to compete against larger retailers.
Identify and explain three methods of promotion that the partnership could use to increase sales.
Consider the advantages and disadvantages of converting the partnership into a private limited company. Recommend whether the partners should do this. Justify your answer.
